mentions.name: Vostride
mentions.description: A free and open-source self-improving QA agent for software teams. It is an agentic testing harness that bundles test runner infrastructure for web and mobile, memory via a vector store with a local embedding model powered by transformers.js, a self-improving loop, and issue reporting.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on building an self-improving QA agent for software teams. Free and open-source.
It is an agentic testing harness with batteries, includes the test runner infra (web & mobile), memory (vector store, local embedding model powered by transformers.js, self improving loop, issue reporting.
